addedBy0264: ["column", "system_tags", "text[]", -1, true, "ARRAY[]::text[]", "", "", "Markers explicitly attached by the app, including reasoning:ratified. Never inferred from old tags; sources.tags keeps user tags and domain: classification.", null]

["constraint", "sources_system_tags_shape", "c", false, false, true, true, false, "CHECK (
CASE
    WHEN (cardinality(system_tags) = 0) THEN true
    WHEN ((array_ndims(system_tags) <> 1) OR (array_lower(system_tags, 1) <> 1)) THEN false
    WHEN (array_position(system_tags, NULL::text) IS NOT NULL) THEN false
    WHEN (cardinality(system_tags) > 16) THEN false
    WHEN ((length(array_to_string(system_tags, ','::text)) - length(replace(array_to_string(system_tags, ','::text), ','::text, ''::text))) <> (cardinality(system_tags) - 1)) THEN false
    WHEN (array_to_string(system_tags, ','::text) !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64}(,[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,64})*$'::text) THEN false
    WHEN (lower(array_to_string(system_tags, ','::text)) ~ '(^|,)domain:'::text) THEN false
    ELSE true
END)"]
